sectors.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
themes: Indonesian retail participation via local exchanges (e.g., Indodax, Tokocrypto) remains a structural bid, amplifying global crypto rallies with higher beta and faster drawdowns.
Regulatory clarity under Bappebti and potential OJK oversight post-2025 creates a compliance-driven wedge, favoring tokens listed on compliant local platforms over unregulated memecoins.
Global liquidity cycles, tied to Fed easing and stablecoin adoption, drive multi-month crypto uplegs; Indonesia's young, mobile-first population accelerates adoption of payment and DeFi use cases.
sectors.ai: Buy the crypto complex on momentum, but rotate toward liquid large-caps (ADA, SUI) and event-driven tokens (TRUMP) rather than chasing PEPE or CAKE. Indonesian retail flow will amplify any upside, yet regulatory overhang persists—use pullbacks to add exposure, not chase green candles. Trim ARB into strength; its +15.5% move is overextended vs. fundamentals.
